message.content: This file defines the core functionality of a USB-to-CDC (CDC) interface for the RP2040 board, acting as a console interface for the Pico SDK. It handles CDC communication, device configuration, and reset operations, integrating with the device's hardware registers and SDK APIs. Key exported functions include setting up the device, sending/receiving data, managing interrupts, and handling configuration requests. Dependencies involve hardware registers, USB drivers, and the SDK, while design decisions focus on compatibility with the RP2040's CDC protocol and ensuring stable operation under various conditions. The code includes detailed comments explaining its purpose and structure.
